newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated at lower levels on Tuesday amid excess liquidity, but dealers said rates were likely to rise on an open market operation expected on Wednesday.
Overnight funds opened at three percent and were at eight percent at the close, one dealer said. Major activity was witnessed in the range of three and six percent.
Dealers said the market was likely to open higher on an expected open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
